title: Theme: Travel and Airport
description: Useful vocabulary and phrases for traveling by plane.

sentences.spanish: Tengo que facturar la maleta antes de ir a la puerta de embarque.
sentences.english: I have to check my suitcase before going to the boarding gate.

sentences.spanish: ¿Me puede poner un asiento de pasillo, por favor?
sentences.english: Can you assign me an aisle seat, please?

sentences.spanish: ¿A qué hora sale el próximo vuelo para Madrid?
sentences.english: What time does the next flight to Madrid leave?

translationChunks.english: the next flight to Madrid leave?

sentences.spanish: Hay mucha cola en el control de seguridad esta mañana.
sentences.english: There is a long queue at security this morning.

translationChunks.spanish: Hay mucha cola en el control de seguridad
translationChunks.english: There is a long queue at security

sentences.spanish: Por favor, enseñe el pasaporte y la tarjeta de embarque.
sentences.english: Please show your passport and boarding pass.

translationChunks.spanish: enseñe el pasaporte y la tarjeta de embarque.
translationChunks.english: show your passport and boarding pass.

sentences.spanish: Prefiero viajar en clase business para tener más espacio.

sentences.spanish: El vuelo lleva dos horas de retraso por el mal tiempo.

translationChunks.english: The plane is about to land

sentences.english: Where can I pick up my luggage?

sentences.english: Do you have anything to declare at customs?

sentences.spanish: El vuelo sale a las ocho y llega a Madrid a las diez.
sentences.english: The flight leaves at eight and arrives in Madrid at ten.

y llega a Madrid a las diez.

sentences.english: I need to show my passport before boarding the plane.

translationChunks.english: I need to show my passport

sentences.spanish: Mi maleta está en la puerta de embarque.
sentences.english: My suitcase is at the boarding gate.
Where can I collect the luggage?

sentences.spanish: El próximo vuelo tiene veinte minutos de retraso.
sentences.english: The next flight is delayed by twenty minutes.
